description: For a paper not yet in the ledger: returns a ready-to-send email link to OpenRepro with the request filled in. Nothing is sent by this tool; the user sends the email if they want to. Like every lookup, the request is counted in the server's usage events, which may keep a requested bare arXiv identifier (such as 2401.12345) and never other text: https://openrepro.org/privacy/#mcp

paper.description: arXiv ID (1607.01759), DOI (10.1126/science.abb9789), an arXiv/doi.org/openrepro.org URL, the paper's title, or a name it is known by (fastText, PINNs, the Leiden algorithm)

why.description: optional: why this paper matters to the requester

name: request_rerun
title: Request a re-run of a paper
